title: Isolation of Nuclei from Frozen Human Peripheral Nerve
author: Alexander Chamessian
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6zqhf5w

steps.title: Collect and Freeze Nerve Samples
steps.instruction: Collect nerve samples from the donor as quickly as possible and prepare for storage.

substeps.instruction: Place the nerve in a clean, labeled container.
Snap-freeze the sample in liquid nitrogen.
Store the sample at -80°C until usage.

steps.title: Retrieve Sample from Storage
steps.instruction: Remove the sample from -80°C storage while ensuring it does not thaw.

substeps.instruction: Maintain the sample on dry ice during and after removal from storage.
